strbuild_host/ — the string builder's host rows (the ink/Logger
pattern): a pure declaration surface. The embedding Rust binds the
bodies (`rut_std::strbuild::pkg()`); the `strbuild`
package wraps them in the `StringBuilder` class.

The registration scope IS the package name; the use path spells it
too (`use strbuild_host::{ sb_new, .. }`).
